proceedings.supporting_quote: On 5 April 1995 at about 8.30 p.m. the applicant, driving a car, was arrested in Slovenj Gradec by officers of the Special Unit and the Slovenj Gradec Police.
On 7 April 1995 the applicant went to the Slovenj Gradec Police and made an oral complaint
on 20 April 1995, the MIA had appointed a ‘working group’... to assess the lawfulness of the procedures

proceedings.deciding_body: Slovenj Gradec District Public Prosecutor's Office
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 15 May 1995 the applicant lodged, through his lawyer, a written criminal complaint ( kazenska ovadba ) with the Slovenj Gradec Police
On 17 January 1997 the Public Prosecutor requested the Slovenj Gradec District Court to open a criminal investigation against the applicant
On 12 May 1997 the Public Prosecutor appealed against this decision. On 4 December 1997 the Maribor Higher Court upheld her appeal
By a judgment of 22 November 1999 the court acquitted the applicant
On 5 January 2000 the Public Prosecutor appealed against the judgment and on 27 September 2000 the Maribor Higher Court quashed the judgment and remitted the case to a new panel for retrial
The judgment of 12 February 2001 issued in the proceedings instituted against the applicant
By a judgment of 12 February 2001, the Slovenj Gradec District Court convicted the applicant as charged
On 9 May 2001 the Maribor Higher Court upheld the conviction
on 11 October 2001 the Slovenj Gradec District Court ordered the applicant to pay an additional sum to cover the costs of one of the witnesses
